timeline.text: Called Curexa before opening; after-hours line, voicemail cut off.
Business-hours retry to Curexa; reached main menu.
Curexa (Bianca Lin) replied: licensed in all 50 states; asked for discovery form.
Curexa discovery form submitted; Max replied open to a call.
Additional vendors vetted; Triad Rx and Beaker skipped, OpenLoop put on hold.
Outreach emailed to RedRock, CareValidate, Beluga and Precision.
Belmar call started to find telehealth partnerships contact.
Added source tags showing why each vendor is on the list.
Belmar 2nd call (~3.5 min): live Colorado rep answered, hung up mid-intro. No named contact; callback not delivered. Menu confirmed pharmacy@belmarpharmacy.com.
SteadyMD call window (planned); no SteadyMD Inkbox call logged by ~18:40 CEST.
Belmar: emailed pharmacy@belmarpharmacy.com; 2nd call reached a Colorado rep then hung up mid-intro.
Precision replied (Britney Stella): open to an intro call, sent catalog; pricing after call, $5k credited implementation deposit, ~30-day go-live. We asked for call times.
Precision (Britney Stella) sent intro call slots for Oct 13–16 ET; waiting on Max to pick one.
RedRock (Lucho, CSR) replied: passed inquiry to marketing for clinic pricing/partnership; expect outreach in 1–2 business days.
SteadyMD main line (+1-800-449-4280) called again; busy/declined (same as earlier attempt). Still no live connect.
Curexa (Bianca Lin) declined: needs 500–1,000+ Rx/month + LegitScript; volume projections below minimum. On hold; reconnect later.
SteadyMD (Lindsey Anderson, VP Enterprise Sales) replied: wants clinical scope, patient population, scale/volume, state coverage and timing before next step. Waiting on Max.
